forecasts.question: Will Iran take a NEW concrete action to fully close the Strait of Hormuz before EOD 2026-06-09?
forecasts.delta_reason: Resolved NO (ambiguity rule applied). No TIER1 source confirmed a NEW discrete concrete closure action between 2026-06-02 and 2026-06-09 distinct from the pre-existing de facto closure. IRGC claimed strikes on vessel 'Panaya', US Fifth Fleet HQ, and American airbase on 3 Jun; CENTCOM confirmed it downed Iranian drones and struck Qeshm radar sites — a US-Iran exchange, not a seizure of or attack on an uninvolved commercial vessel. IRGC claimed a 'disabled' tanker 5-6 Jun; CENTCOM did not confirm; single unverified state-media claim without NAVCENT/UKMTO corroboration = AMBIGUOUS, resolved NO per ambiguity rule.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a NEW concrete Iranian closure action between 2026-06-02 and 2026-06-09: fresh mine-laying, a formally declared total-closure/exclusion order, or a new IRGC seizure/attack on a commercial vessel.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + a US/UK maritime authority (NAVCENT/UKMTO) advisory.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Repetition of existing warnings or continuation of the pre-existing de facto closure does NOT count; a single unverified state-media claim without corroboration = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will Iran and the US publicly confirm a signed written framework before EOD 2026-06-05?
forecasts.delta_reason: Resolved NO. 60-day MOU reached tentative agreement 28 May but Trump did not give final approval (Vance: 'a couple of language points'). Iran suspended all mediator-channel communications 1 Jun over Israel's Lebanon offensive. No named US principal AND named Iranian principal jointly confirmed a signed written framework before EOD 2026-06-05. On 9 Jun Iran rejected US proposal and submitted counter-offer through Oman — after the horizon.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a named US administration official AND a named Iranian official publicly confirm a signed written framework (by any name); OR if the document text is published by Axios/Reuters/State Dept or Iran MFA with both parties acknowledging authenticity. Verbal 'agreement in principle' does not count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: At minimum Reuters AND one of Axios/AP/AFP quoting named US AND Iranian principals (not envoys alone). Official Iran MFA statement or State Dept press release also resolves.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Agreement by envoys only without principal confirmation (Trump/Pezeshkian or Mojtaba Khamenei's office) within 72h = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. If Iran signs but Khamenei's office disavows within 72h = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
